fit_reason: Whole 2007 BMW 328xi sedan listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Hazy, yellowed headlight lenses on both front headlights
Water spots and dried residue across the hood and roof of the black paint

message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2007 BMW 328xi. In the photos the headlights look hazy and the black paint on the hood and roof shows water spots and dullness, which black cars really show off. We do mobile pre-sale details, including headlight restoration and a paint buff, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
